LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS 7.1.2 ARTICULATION OF LETTER SOUNDS.

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.1: Observing and Articulating signs 7.1.2 Articulation of letter sounds.
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating signs 7.1.2 Articulation of letter sounds., part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Which letters of the alphabet can you remember? 2. Where do you store water at home?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating signs 7.1.2 Articulation of letter sounds. together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: observation and signing skills as learner articulates letters and chants rhymes.

● Self-efficacy as learner chants rhymes in class with the other learners watching for peer assessment.

Value:

● Respect: patience as learner learn to take turns while articulating the letters.

● Unity: equity as learner chants rhymes with others in unison.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Effective communication: The learner correctly articulates letter sounds in preparation for reading of words.

Link to other Activity Areas:

Articulation of letter sounds is necessary in all learning areas and for effective fingerspelling and signing in signed communication.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Signed audio visual clips, books, Flash cards, charts, pictures
